definition: The square root of the mean of 0.5 ln(high / low) squared less (2 ln 2 - 1) ln(close / open) squared, over the last window bars, per bar and not annualised.
boundaries: Garman and Klass's practical estimator from open, high, low and close; it assumes no drift and ignores the gap from the last close to the open.
recognition: Higher means bigger moves inside the bars.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
